sample_unit: paired facial image cases (460 model evaluations)

links.outcome: Inter-run reproducibility (Fleiss' kappa) across 5 repeated runs of MLLM regional improvement ratings
links.effect: Inter-run reliability varied widely (κ -0.113 to 0.719). High reliability did not imply correctness.

links.outcome: MLLM region-specific improvement detection accuracy versus majority-class baselines
links.effect: All models identified posttreatment image (100%), but region-specific detection frequently failed to exceed majority-class baselines (65.2%-91.3%); no model reached the periorbital baseline.
links.quote: Region-specific improvement detection frequently failed to exceed majority-class baselines (65.2%-91.3%).

unlisted_practices: Domain-specific fine-tuning and expert-rater benchmarking for aesthetic outcome assessment

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and reliability of four multimodal LLMs in assessing aesthetic outcomes from paired facial photographs after botulinum toxin treatment without evaluating a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
